purpose: Describe passing through stages, time, or places before a result.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
After training, I was assigned to the site.
We met again after ten years.
We headed to Kobe via Kyoto.
restrictions: Often summarizes a process leading to a new stage.
mistake: 経て does not itself imply success; the later predicate supplies the outcome.
